assumptions: Concrete mix 1:1.5:3; mortar 1:6; plaster 1:4
Wet→dry factors 1.54 (concrete), 1.27 (mortar/plaster)
Cement density 1440 kg/m³, bag 50 kg
items.formula: Σ over concrete, mortar, plaster: Dry volume × cement part / Σ parts × density ÷ bag weight
items.name: Cement
items.note: Sources (bags, net): concrete 193.5; masonry mortar 70.8; plaster 69.2

assumptions: Mixes as for cement; sand proportions 1.5 (concrete), 6 (mortar), 4 (plaster)
items.formula: Σ Dry volume × sand part / Σ parts (concrete, mortar, plaster)
items.name: Sand
items.note: Sources (m³, net): concrete 10.08; masonry mortar 14.74; plaster 9.61

assumptions: Concrete mix 1:1.5:3
Dry volume = wet × 1.54
items.formula: Dry concrete volume × aggregate part / Σ parts
items.name: Coarse Aggregate

assumptions: Steel intensity 80 kg/m³ of concrete (engineer to confirm from structural design)
items.formula: Weight = Concrete volume × steel intensity
items.name: Reinforcement Steel
items.note: Slab reinforcement estimate only; columns, beams and footings need structural drawings.

assumptions: Slab thickness 0.15 m on 2 floor(s), footprint 80.00 m²
Frame allowance 0 % (columns/beams/footings not detailed)
items.formula: V = Footprint × Slab thickness × Floors
items.name: Concrete (RCC slabs)
items.note: Costed only when ready-mix supply is selected; otherwise priced through cement, sand and aggregate.

assumptions: External wall 0.23 m (brick), internal wall 0.115 m (brick)
Wall height 3 m; external perimeter 36.00 m × 2 floor(s)
Internal wall length ≈ (Σ room perimeters − external perimeter) ÷ 2 per floor = 44.00 m total (shared walls counted once)
Openings deducted (estimated from room door/window counts): 12 window(s) 17.3 m², 9 door(s) 16.4 m² (entrance + internal)
Net masonry volume 58.75 m³; mortar joint 10 mm
items.formula: Count = ⌈Net masonry volume ÷ ((l+j)(w+j)(h+j))⌉, unit 0.19×0.09×0.09 m
items.name: Bricks

assumptions: Mix 1:6
Net masonry volume 58.75 m³
items.formula: Wet mortar = Masonry volume − (unit count × unit volume)
items.name: Masonry Mortar
items.note: Quantity only; cost is captured through cement and sand.

assumptions: Plastered area 788.6 m² (both wall faces net of openings + ceilings)
Thickness 12 mm; mix 1:4
items.formula: Plaster volume = Plastered area × thickness
items.name: Plaster
items.note: Quantity only; cost is captured through cement and sand.

assumptions: Net tiled area 160.00 m²; tile 0.6×0.6 m = 0.360 m²
Tiled rooms: 10 of 10 (net room floor areas).
Wall tiling (e.g. bathrooms, kitchens) is not included
items.formula: N = ⌈Net floor area ÷ Area per tile⌉ (wastage applied to area before rounding)
items.name: Floor Tiles

assumptions: Net paintable area 788.6 m²; 2 coat(s); coverage 10 m²/L/coat
Primer and external weather coat are not itemised
items.formula: Paint = Net paintable area × Coats ÷ Coverage per litre
items.name: Paint

materials.specification: Blended cement with pozzolanic material, 50 kg bag.

materials.name: River Sand

materials.name: Manufactured Sand (M-Sand)

materials.durability_notes: Standard size for slabs and beams.

materials.durability_notes: Higher ductility grade; check structural drawings for the required grade.
materials.name: TMT Reinforcement Bar Fe 500D

materials.durability_notes: Pumping and delivery charges may be extra.
materials.name: Ready-Mix Concrete M20

materials.durability_notes: Higher grade; confirm with structural design.
materials.name: Ready-Mix Concrete M25

materials.durability_notes: Widely available; water absorption varies by kiln.
materials.name: Burnt Clay Brick

materials.durability_notes: Uniform size can reduce mortar use.
